text:
maria gomez: ok team — quick thread plan for Morning Canvas launch tomorrow morning. need final assets + who owns followups. :rocket:
alex lee: sending animations in 10. 30s clip + 3 variant thumbnails. will upload to /marketing/assets in a min. :movie_camera:
sam irwin: i've got copy A/B for X + linkedin. copy A leans technical, B is product-story. pick one for top-of-funnel and one for retarget.
olivia chan: can we keep linkedin as product-story (B) and X as A? better CTR on X with the hook.
jordan reyes: agree. also routing: all inbound DMs go to @sam irwin, replies to comments -> community queue (I'll triage).
maria gomez: perfect. alex — need the thumbnails named exactly: morning-canvas-30s-v1.jpg, -v2.jpg, -v3.jpg. include alt text.
alex lee: done. uploaded: /marketing/assets/morning-canvas/30s/

maria gomez: quick UTM block for the registration link — use this so we can attribute: ```?utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_or_linkedin&utm_campaign=mc_launch_2024&utm_content={variant}```

sam irwin: noted. will swap {variant} with x-a or ln-b in scheduler.

jess-bot: reminder: social-scheduler queue opens at 08:30 PST for scheduled posts. running preflight at 08:00. :robot_face:
social-scheduler: scheduled post (X) queued for 08:45 PST — copy A + vid30 + thumbnail v1.

maria gomez: need one microthread for X: root post + 3 followups. outline: 1) product problem 2) how Morning Canvas helps 3) CTA -> register. Sam can you draft the three followups?
sam irwin: drafting now. posting here in 5.

alex lee: PSA — gif for replies ready (looping 6s). size optimized for X.
olivia chan: engagement plan: reply templates for top 10 inbound questions. i'll write the first 5 by 09:00.
jordan reyes: i'll make a quick Airtable view for incoming people who register + matched leads so we can route to SDRs. link later.
maria gomez: post-copy variations we'll test: headline emphasis on speed vs cost savings. sampling 50/50. add the variant to the UTM.
sam irwin: posting microthread drafts now:

sam irwin: "Root: Building with LLMs used to mean tradeoffs: slow inference or huge cost. Morning Canvas flips that — predictable latency, lower unit costs. Register for the demo + checklist: <link>?utm_content=x-a :eyes:
Followup 1: Quick peek at the dashboard — realtime token cost breakdown + per-route SLAs.
Followup 2: Our autoscaling keeps latency under SLOs during surges (customer story teaser).
Followup 3: RSVP -> demo + 10-min setup guide. link in bio. :sparkles:"

olivia chan: love the tone. small ask: change "link in bio" to "registration link" for LinkedIn.
sam irwin: updated.

maria gomez: last things — comment triage hours: 09:00–17:00 PST. if anything urgent after-hours, tag @jordan reyes. :phone:

social-scheduler: confirm: LinkedIn post scheduled for 09:00 PST with copy B + static image v2.
maria gomez: awesome. can someone do a quick preflight checklist at 08:05? i'll run through brand + compliance.
jess-bot: noted. preflight ping will post to this thread at 08:05 PST.

alex lee: everything green on assets. Good luck team :thumbsup:
